messages.content:
use tools and make this game mate 
Create a complete Minecraft-style BedWars game in Roblox.

Core Gameplay:
- Multiple teams (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow)
- Each team has a bed that allows players to respawn
- If a team's bed is destroyed, players can no longer respawn
- Last team with surviving players wins

Map:
- Floating islands in the sky
- One spawn island per team
- Central island containing valuable resources
- Bridges can be built between islands
- Minecraft-inspired blocky aesthetic

Building System:
- Players can place and destroy blocks
- Blocks snap to a grid
- Different block types (Wool, Wood, Stone, Obsidian)
- Prevent placing blocks inside players
- Smooth building experience similar to BedWars

Resources:
- Iron generator at team base
- Gold generator at team base
- Emerald generators at center island
- Resources automatically spawn over time
- Players collect resources by touching them

Shop System:
- Shop NPC at each team base
- Purchase blocks, weapons, armor, tools, and utility items
- Resource-based economy (Iron, Gold, Emeralds)

Combat:
- Sword combat with knockback
- Wooden, Stone, Iron, Diamond swords
- Armor tiers
- Health and damage system
- PvP enabled between teams only

Bed Mechanics:
- Beds can be damaged and destroyed by enemy players
- Visual effects when a bed is destroyed
- Team-wide notification when a bed breaks

Progression:
- Team upgrades (generator speed, armor upgrades, damage upgrades)
- Upgrade shop
- Permanent upgrades for the current match

UI:
- Team scoreboard
- Resource counters
- Bed status indicators
- Match timer
- Shop interfaces
- Victory/defeat screens

Game Systems:
- Lobby system
- Matchmaking
- Minimum player requirement
- Round start countdown
- Automatic winner detection
- Match reset after completion

Code Requirements:
- Use modular scripts
- Organize systems into separate modules
- Include comments for major systems
- Optimize for multiplayer performance
- Follow Roblox best practices

Deliver:
- Full folder structure
- Required scripts
- RemoteEvents setup
- Data flow explanation
- Step-by-step implementation order
